name: str
note: str(file_reference) was the .NET type name, CompAnalytics.Contracts.FileReference; it is now the contract's text. Nothing reads it.

FileReference.Uri is a str subclass (composapy.contracts.uri.Uri) with the System.Uri members scripts use, and every member of an absolute URI returns what System.Uri returned. A System.Uri raised TypeError when compared with a string and the candidate's compares equal to its text; a relative URI raises RelativeUriError where System.Uri raised InvalidOperationException, with the same message (Decision Log, 2026-10-27).

The server's message is the same; the baseline raised System.ServiceModel.FaultException[FaultDetail] with the .NET stack trace appended and the candidate raises composapy.exceptions.ServiceFault with the server's message (Exceptions, R5).

name: tablecreator.headers_type
note: Table.Headers was a .NET List[String] and is a NetList, a list with the List<T> members a script could call (Count, Contains, IndexOf, LastIndexOf, ToArray, GetRange, Add, AddRange, Insert, Remove, RemoveAt, Reverse, Sort, Clear). The type name differs; net_list_members compares every member against the baseline (Decision Log, 2026-10-27).

name: headers.index_negative
note: Python's own behavior is kept where the .NET wrapper refused: a negative index counts from the end; List<T> raised ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

name: headers.slice
note: Python's own behavior is kept where the .NET wrapper refused: slicing works; the .NET wrapper raised TypeError.

name: headers.Contains_wrong_type
note: Python's own behavior is kept where the .NET wrapper refused: Contains(5) on a list of strings is False; the .NET wrapper raised TypeError for the wrong element type.

name: headers.Add_wrong_type
note: Python's own behavior is kept where the .NET wrapper refused: Add(5) to a list of strings is accepted, because a Python list has no element type; the .NET wrapper raised TypeError.

name: headers.AddRange
note: Python's own behavior is kept where the .NET wrapper refused: AddRange takes a Python list, which the .NET wrapper refused with TypeError; any iterable is accepted.

name: headers.equals_a_list

name: headers.not_equals_a_list
